name: opensource-hub-db-setup
description: Cloudflare D1 数据库初始化脚本

scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute opensource-hub-db --command "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS search_analytics; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS download_stats; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS app_security; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS app_ai_content; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS app_versions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS apps; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS categories; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tags; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS system_config;" && npm run db:migrate
